typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Action as string,
		Status as string,
		{Start Date} as string,
		{End Date} as string,
		{Path (Key Field)} as string,
		Market as string,
		Territory as string,
		{Media Type} as string,
		Segment as string,
		Program as string,
		Campaign as string,
		{Lead Source Type} as string,
		{Lead Source Name} as string,
		{800#} as string,
		DNIS as string,
		{Event ID (Key Field)} as string,
		{Lead Source Weight} as string,
		{Lead Source Type Priority} as string,
		{Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)} as string,
		{Agent #} as string,
		{LG Suffix} as string,
		{Referral ID Req (Y/N)} as string,
		{Referral ID Tool Tip (mouse over)} as string,
		Creative as string,
		Offer as string,
		{Client Internal Job#} as string,
		{Ad Agency Job#} as string,
		{Ad Agency ID} as string,
		{URL (Media Path)} as string,
		{CID Code (Application Code)} as string,
		{CID Referring URL} as string,
		{Prospect Type} as string,
		Campaign_ID as string,
		Campaign_Event_ID as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_CampaignUpdate*']) ~> source1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> AddADFId
AddADFId split(isNull(Status)||isNull({Start Date})||isNull({Path (Key Field)})||isNull(Program)||isNull(Campaign)||isNull({Lead Source Name})||(({Path (Key Field)} == 'Inbound Call')&&(isNull({800#})))||isNull({Event ID (Key Field)})||isNull({Lead Source Weight})||isNull({Prospect Type}),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Reject, Update)
ConditionalSplit1@Reject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Required Field Contains NULL Value: ', iif(isNull(Status), 'Status ', ''), iif(isNull({Start Date}), '{Start Date} ', ''), iif(isNull({Path (Key Field)}), '{Path (Key Field)} ', ''), iif(isNull(Program), 'Program ', ''), iif(isNull(Campaign), 'Campaign ', ''), iif(isNull({Lead Source Name}), '{Lead Source Name} ', ''), iif((({Path (Key Field)} == 'Inbound Call') && isNull({800#})), '{800#} ', ''), iif((({Path (Key Field)} == 'Inbound Call') && isNull(DNIS)), 'DNIS ', ''), iif(isNull({Event ID (Key Field)}), '{Event ID (Key Field)} ', ''), iif(isNull({Lead Source Weight}), '{Lead Source Weight} ', ''), iif(isNull({Prospect Type}), '{Prospect Type} ', ''))) ~> RejectReason
RejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@Update derive({Start Date} = coalesce(toString(toDate({Start Date}, 'MM/dd/yyyy')), {Start Date}),
		{End Date} = coalesce(toString(toDate({End Date}, 'MM/dd/yyyy')), {End Date}),
		DNIS = iif(isNull(DNIS),{Event ID (Key Field)},DNIS),
		LOB__c = 'KPMA_Telesales',
		Status = toBoolean(iif(upper(Status)=='A','true',iif(upper(Status)=='I','false',''))),
		{Referral ID Req (Y/N)} = toBoolean(iif(isNull({Referral ID Req (Y/N)}),'false',{Referral ID Req (Y/N)})),
		{Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)} = toBoolean(iif(isNull({Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)}),'false',{Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)}))) ~> DerivedColumn1
Filter2 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		IsActive = Status,
		StartDate = {Start Date},
		EndDate = {End Date},
		Media_Path_Name__c = {Path (Key Field)},
		Media_Market__c = Market,
		Media_Territory_Name__c = Territory,
		Media_Type__c = {Media Type},
		Media_Segment_Name__c = Segment,
		Program__c = Program,
		Name = Campaign,
		Lead_Source_Type__c = {Lead Source Type},
		LeadSourceName__c = {Lead Source Name},
		TFN__c = {800#},
		DNIS__c = DNIS,
		Promo_Id__c = {Event ID (Key Field)},
		Lead_Source_Weight__c = {Lead Source Weight},
		LeadSourceTypePriority__c = {Lead Source Type Priority},
		Use_CM_Agent__c = {Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)},
		agent_number__c = {Agent #},
		cls_lgs__c = {LG Suffix},
		cls_ref_id__c = {Referral ID Req (Y/N)},
		REFERRAL_ID_TOOL_TIP__C = {Referral ID Tool Tip (mouse over)},
		Creative__c = Creative,
		Offer__c = Offer,
		Client_Internal_Job__c = {Client Internal Job#},
		Ad_Agency_Job__c = {Ad Agency Job#},
		cls_ad_id__c = {Ad Agency ID},
		Path__c = {URL (Media Path)},
		CID_CODE__C = {CID Code (Application Code)},
		CID_Referring_URL__c = {CID Referring URL},
		Prospect_Type__c = {Prospect Type},
		LOB__c,
		KP_Program__c = Campaign_ID,
		Event_SysID__c = Campaign_Event_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SelectInsert
DerivedColumn1 filter(upper(Action) == 'U') ~> Filter1
DerivedColumn1 filter(upper(Action) == 'N') ~> Filter2
Filter1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		IsActive = Status,
		StartDate = {Start Date},
		EndDate = {End Date},
		Media_Path_Name__c = {Path (Key Field)},
		Media_Market__c = Market,
		Media_Territory_Name__c = Territory,
		Media_Type__c = {Media Type},
		Media_Segment_Name__c = Segment,
		Program__c = Program,
		Name = Campaign,
		Lead_Source_Type__c = {Lead Source Type},
		LeadSourceName__c = {Lead Source Name},
		TFN__c = {800#},
		DNIS__c = DNIS,
		Promo_Id__c = {Event ID (Key Field)},
		Lead_Source_Weight__c = {Lead Source Weight},
		LeadSourceTypePriority__c = {Lead Source Type Priority},
		Use_CM_Agent__c = {Use CM Agent#  (Y/N)},
		agent_number__c = {Agent #},
		cls_lgs__c = {LG Suffix},
		cls_ref_id__c = {Referral ID Req (Y/N)},
		REFERRAL_ID_TOOL_TIP__C = {Referral ID Tool Tip (mouse over)},
		Creative__c = Creative,
		Offer__c = Offer,
		Client_Internal_Job__c = {Client Internal Job#},
		Ad_Agency_Job__c = {Ad Agency Job#},
		cls_ad_id__c = {Ad Agency ID},
		Path__c = {URL (Media Path)},
		CID_CODE__C = {CID Code (Application Code)},
		CID_Referring_URL__c = {CID Referring URL},
		Prospect_Type__c = {Prospect Type},
		LOB__c,
		KP_Program__c = Campaign_ID,
		Event_SysID__c = Campaign_Event_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SelectUpdate
AddADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_CampaignUpdate_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedRaw
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_CampaignUpdate_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReject
SelectUpdate sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_CampaignUpdate_Campaign.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toUpsert
SelectInsert sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_CampaignUpdate_Campaign.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toInsert
